policy.threshold_rationale: Research project setting: block at any estimated S1/G1/R1 or above. NOAA scale categories are not official EVA authorization criteria.
policy.kp_to_g_method: Explicit lower bounds 14/3, 17/3, 20/3, 23/3, 9 following NOAA forecast third-scale labels; direct comparison for continuous forecasts, no rounding. Kp outside [0,9] is invalid.

probability_definition: P(S>=1 or G>=1 or R>=1); independent of configured EVA block levels
